observation_summary: The test fails with a NotSerializableException when attempting to serialize a mock created with RETURNS_DEEP_STUBS. The internal anonymous class used by the deep stub implementation does not implement the Serializable interface, preventing the entire mock object graph from being serialized.
reasoning_summary: The failure is caused by the absence of the Serializable interface on an internal class (ReturnsDeepStubs$2) that is part of the mock's state. This is a design-level capability gap where the deep stubbing mechanism was not designed to support serialization of its internal state, requiring a structural change to the class definition to implement the necessary interface.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While serialization involves a relationship between objects, the root cause is the missing capability (Serializable interface) on the class itself, which is a structural design omission.
